work_orders.title: Fire panel loop 3 comm fault investigation
work_orders.description: Intermittent RS-485 errors on loop 3. 47 errors in 24 hours. Inspected terminations at fire panel and first 3 junction boxes.
work_orders.resolution: Tightened loose terminations at JB-L3-02. Comm errors reduced but not eliminated. Suspected cable damage in riser between L2 and L3. Megger test needed.

work_orders.title: Emergency fire loop 3 cable replacement
work_orders.description: Loop 3 total failure — 42 detectors offline. Megger test confirmed insulation breakdown in riser cable (0.2 Mohm, spec > 20 Mohm). Water ingress from roof leak damaged cable.
work_orders.resolution: Riser cable replaced L2-L3 (30m FP200 Gold). All terminations remade. Post-repair: 0 comm errors, bus voltage 12.2V, all 42 detectors reporting. Fire watch stood down.
